entities.name: Michèle Magema
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michèle Magema is a Congolese-French visual artist, known primarily for her video, performance, photography and drawing. Born in Kinshasa, DRC, she currently resides in Nevers, France. Magema's work considers memory, the multiplicity of histories, and temporality.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michèle Magema is a Congolese-French visual artist, known primarily for her video, performance, photography and drawing. Born in Kinshasa, DRC, she currently resides in Nevers, France. Magema's work considers memory, the multiplicity of histories, and temporality.
